newsitem.title: USA: PRESS DIGEST - Wall Street Journal - Nov 6.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - Wall Street Journal - Nov 6.

text.p: Texas Instruments Inc is planning to sell its defense electronics holdings worth more than $2 billion and McDonnell Douglas Corp is one of the interested buyers, the Wall Street Journal reported on Wednesday.
- Germany's Henkel KGaA has embarked on a hostile tender offer for the 65 percent of Loctite Corp shares that it does not already own.
- Airbus Industrie has received orders from USAir Group Inc for 120 of its small jets with list prices totalling about $5.3 billion.
- Walt Disney Co abandoned its efforts to stop a shareholder resolution related to its alleged use of sweatshop labor.
- Ford Motor Co reported a 2.7 percent rise in October sales.
- General Motors Corp and the United Automobile Workers union reached a tentative agreement to resolve a strike at a Wisconsin truck plant.
- The U.S. Justice Department has allowed SBC Communications Inc to buy Pacific Telesis Group as well as U S West Inc's purchase of Continental Cablevision Inc.
- Norfolk Southern Corp cancelled talks with CSX Corp about dividing up Conrail Inc, reaffirming its plans to make a rival bid for the railroad company.
- The trustee of New York's retirement fund said the disclosure of racist remarks in a lawsuit against Texaco Inc has hurt the company.
- The United Steelworkers union reached a tentative agreement with Bridgestone/Firestone in the midst of a labor dispute.
- The Dow Jones industrial ended higher and came close to setting a new record.
- Investor Bennett LeBow submitted his own slate of directors for RJR Nabisco Holdings Corp, distancing himself from investor Carl Icahn.
- The head of Seagram Co Ltd unit MCA's them-park division resigned.
- Foreign and domestic investors were buoyed by the latest economic indicators as bond prices rose and the 30-year bond yield fell.
- U.S. investors do not appear to be interested in the $10 billion initial public offering by Germany's Deutsche Telekom .
